messages:
maria: Heads-up — I ran a continuous-batching canary across mixed fleet (A10/T4/L4/A100/H100) to adjust per-card max-tokens-per-batch. Results are weird: A100 p95 latency up ~8% when bumping max_tokens 65k->80k, while T4 improved tail. Posting notes and logs.

raj: interesting. did KV-cache hit rates change? A100 tends to degrade when KV fragmentation increases.

noah: can you share the profiler trace / kernel selection outputs?

maria: here's the short log excerpt (from perf-trace):
```
# canary: slotting_v3 -> max_tokens map
A10: max_tokens=40000, kernel=fast_attn_v2, avg_p95=120ms
T4:  max_tokens=25000, kernel=pack_concat, avg_p95=210ms
L4:  max_tokens=30000, kernel=fast_attn_v1, avg_p95=95ms
A100: max_tokens=80000, kernel=matmul_fused_v3, avg_p95=310ms (+8%)
H100: max_tokens=100000, kernel=matmul_fused_v4, avg_p95=140ms
KV-frag(A100)=28% -> extra memcpy on KV flush path
```

sophia: that KV-frag number stands out. When frag>20% we see memmove cost + kernel fallback. Could explain the A100 regression.

raj: also check batching queue policy — if A100 pads a lot due to a few long queries, it pushes latency. Did you enable mixed-packing?

maria: yes mixed-packing=true. I suspect padding + KV frag + matmul_fused_v3 not yet optimized for long seqs. Kernel selector chose fused v3 because of throughput target.

noah: proposal: add soft token budget caps per GPU family + a short-term KV-frag backoff. heuristics:
- token_budget_targets: A10=40k, T4=22k, L4=30k, A100=60k, H100=90k
- queue_policy: prefer smaller slots on A100 when KV-frag>15%
- kernel fallback: force matmul_fused_v4 for long sequences on A100 if available

sophia: +1. Also instrument a KV-frag gauge and emit trace span when memmove exceeds 2ms.

maria: ran a quick microbenchmark switching A100 max_tokens->60k and added KV gating. Result: p95 dropped back to baseline, throughput unchanged. I'll open an experiment PR with configs.

perf-bot: experiment snapshot saved -> s3://perf-archive/slotting_v3/4567890123

dl-bot: created PR #1423: runtime: slotting_v3 token-budget matrix + KV gating

maria: action items:
1) run fleet canary with token_budget_targets above and KV-gate on A100 (no mixed-packing change) — @raj to kick off
2) add KV-frag metric + memmove span to tracer — @sophia
3) integrate kernel selector tweak to prefer v4 for seq>8k on A100 — @noah
4) collect 48h rolling traces and compare p95/throughput/cost — I'll collate

raj: starting canary now. ETA ~2h.

noah: I'll draft kernel selector patch and perf test.

sophia: adding instrument in next PR.

maria: thanks — will follow up with results here. :thumbsup:
